label: CloakBrowser (stealth Chromium)

identityCopy.notes: Identity tier for Chromium: the fingerprint seed, Local State (it holds the key that decrypts every cookie and password below, so it is copied first), Preferences, saved logins, cookies, autofill, history, localStorage and session-storage tokens, extension state and the installed extensions themselves. Left out: IndexedDB and the OPFS file system (388 MB and 131 MB in the measured profile), caches, metrics dumps and history-free bulk, which is why sites whose login lives in IndexedDB (WhatsApp Web, Google Drive, OneDrive, Notion) may ask you to sign in again. Measured on this machine: ~28 MB without installed extensions, ~9 MB more of extension state. A copy on a busy base can be seconds stale.

notes: Default engine. CloakBrowser stealth-patched Chromium on Patchright 1.64.1. Exposes the full 72-tool Playwright MCP browser contract plus cloakbrowser_binary_info and cloakbrowser_bridge_info.
